title: Atomic Chat Staff Picks
description: Schema for the remote staff-picks manifest consumed by the Atomic Chat Hub. Intentionally separate from models/schema.json: recommended.json is frozen for shipped production clients and must keep schema_version 1 with its original entry shape.

schema_version.description: Bump this when the shape of a pick entry changes in a backwards-incompatible way. Ship the client that understands the new version BEFORE publishing it.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; refresh on every meaningful change.

title.description: Display name override. Falls back to the name derived from the repo id.

summary.description: One-line English description. Used when description_key is absent or missing from the locale bundle.

description_key.description: i18n key for the chip label. Must start with 'hub:' and exist in web-app/src/locales/*/hub.json. Takes priority over summary.

icon.description: Key of a bundled icon resolved by web-app/src/lib/model-logo.ts. Unknown keys fall back to the model-family logo, then to a letter.

format.description: Build format of this repo. The Hub shows GGUF picks by default and MLX picks only while the MLX format filter is selected, so this must be declared here: it decides which entries are resolved at all, before any catalog lookup or Hugging Face request. MLX entries should also carry platforms: ["macos"].

categories.description: Capability pills shown on the list row.

platforms.description: If omitted, the pick is shown on every platform.

order.description: Lower sorts first. Entries without an order sort after those with one.

active.description: Set to false to hide a pick without removing the entry.
